artifacts.notes: Internet Archive describes 874 source images, while this exact PDF has 872 PDF pages. The article 'Jesus Christ' begins partway through PDF page 426 (printed p. 374) and ends partway through PDF page 439 (printed p. 385). Its chronology key is on PDF page 430 (printed p. 378), and the sixth, seventh, and ninth journey notices are on PDF pages 432-433 (printed pp. 380-381). The embedded optical character recognition was used only to locate pages; wording, dates, routes, article bounds, and byline were checked on the page images.
artifacts.rights_basis: The underlying 1910 American printing is in the United States public domain by date of publication. The Internet Archive delivers a mechanical scan and automated text layer of that public-domain printing; no new copyright is claimed here over the facsimile, and the 135,877,116-byte file is not redistributed from this repository.
